rootCause: _semanticBlocks returns [] for empty paragraphs. The normal section renderer writes the section title only inside its block loop, so a legitimate title-only narrative section emits no PDF widget. The canonical render plainText still includes the heading, which can make render-text-only parity tests pass incorrectly.

independentRerun.note: Render-only diagnostic success is NOT PDF parity success.

separateExtractionLimitation: Chrome PDF pypdf extraction contains NUL substitutions for some Thai glyphs. Known/Unknown full-field extraction reports 55/12 mismatches, not zero. Visually opened pages render those glyphs. No text scrub or guessed glyph replacement was applied and no complete cross-PDF parity pass is claimed.
requiredAuthority: Explicit authorization for a minimal Known PDF title-only section rendering fix plus actual-PDF regression, or an explicit decision to defer this out-of-scope defect. Do not weaken the parity check or silently exclude the heading.
